sources.snippet: Open Photo AI Models This repository contains a collection of AI models used by Open Photo AI for photo enhancement tasks, including face detection, face recovery, image upscaling, denoising, sharpening, light adjustment, and color balance. Each model is designed to perform a specific function to improve the quality of photographs. Models
